analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the "Last updated" date (line 3) and adds "constant or variable frame rate" to the video_url description (line 52). The units supplied for review (head_text lines 405-1309) are surrounding unchanged documentation, so there is no code, config or control change in them. I reviewed the unchanged text for contradictions with the threat model. The logout, drain, enroll and App Attest descriptions (T-053, TB-011, A-008) and the prefix-cache text (T-041) are consistent with the canonical model. They make no new claims about serving authorization, receipt policy or cache TTL. The documentation only widens the stated video input support to variable frame rate, which is a doc description of an inline-video decode path. Residual question for later passes, not a finding: the actual code change implementing variable-frame-rate video is not in this batch. If it adds temp-file handling or a new decoder, T-050 (inline video plaintext in temp files) and TB-007 media handling should be checked there. No security regression is identifiable from the supplied evidence.
